claim: The supplied material does not include experimental design, cell types, cancer types, effect sizes, direct microRNA-binding assays, or causal rescue data.
The strength, kinetics, and generalizability of mosGCTL-1 induction cannot be independently assessed from the supplied material alone.
None of the supplied sources directly tests the broad term “suboptimal nutrition” as a single exposure.
The strongest evidence comes from modeled comparative risk assessment rather than primary causal trials.
The abstract does not provide organ-specific quantitative measurements for brain or adrenal ascorbic acid.
The supplied sources do not establish long-term clinical outcomes in patients.
